payload.content: Orphan-detection pitfall (2026-07-04): before any pkill on processes that "look orphaned" (PPID=1, days old, high RSS), trace parent chain via `cat /proc/$pid/status | grep PPid` and check `kill -0 $ppid` to verify parent is genuinely dead vs detached from an active gateway. Caught a near-miss: 10 tsserver workers PPID=1 looked like leaks from old sessions, but their grandparent was the live hermes-gateway. Killing them would have broken my own LSP stack. Rule: only kill what is provably dead, never what looks dead. Documented in skill vps-ram-pressure.
